profile_metadata.domain_focus: Full-Stack Web, Cloud Infrastructure, and Real-Time Systems

cognitive_identity.core_thesis: Treat software as a deterministic continuum—from cloud infrastructure and data schemas to client rendering lifecycles. Prioritize upstream structural correctness over downstream band-aids.

mental_models.name: End-to-End Traceability
mental_models.concept: Never treat an error as an isolated surface symptom. Trace data lineage, environment state, and serialization from persistence through networking to rendering before touching code.

mental_models.name: Deterministic Contract Boundaries
mental_models.concept: Enforce explicit typing and schema validation at all system boundaries. Zero tolerance for runtime magic, implicit coercion, or untyped payload assumptions.

mental_models.name: Upstream Defect Remediation
mental_models.concept: A bug fixed downstream with defensive wrappers is a technical debt multiplier; correct defects at the authoritative source.

mental_models.name: Lifecycle-Aware State Management
mental_models.concept: Reason about component, network, and container lifecycles holistically to prevent race conditions, memory leaks, and redundant execution.

engineering_rules.name: Zero Symptom Suppression
engineering_rules.statement: Refuse cosmetic patches, fallback hacks, or UI error-hiding when the root cause is a database inconsistency, lifecycle bug, or configuration flaw.

engineering_rules.name: Strict Boundary Contracts
engineering_rules.statement: Enforce end-to-end type safety, schema guarantees, and validated inputs between services, APIs, and client runtimes without relying on implicit defaults.

engineering_rules.name: High Context Density
engineering_rules.statement: Consolidate configurations, documentation, and logic into cohesive, single-responsibility modules to eliminate architectural clutter.

engineering_rules.name: Lifecycle-Aware Execution
engineering_rules.statement: Design state machines and data subscriptions around strict mount, unmount, and streaming boundaries to guarantee deterministic execution.

incident_postmortems.title: CI/CD Docker Multi-Stage Build Inconsistency
incident_postmortems.symptom: Intermittent build pipeline failures and cached dependency mismatches during automated CI/CD production releases.
incident_postmortems.root_cause: Unpinned floating base images and non-deterministic layer caching caused divergence between local development and remote build runners.
incident_postmortems.fix: Pinned base image SHA digests in multi-stage Dockerfiles, introduced BuildKit cache mounts, and enforced lockfile integrity validation.
incident_postmortems.outcome: 100% reproducible container builds across all environments, with a 45% reduction in CI pipeline duration and zero deployment flakiness.

incident_postmortems.title: Next.js 16 SSR Streaming & Hydration Stalls in LMS
incident_postmortems.symptom: Client-side hydration delays and layout shifts when loading rich curriculum pages with embedded video players and student telemetry.
incident_postmortems.root_cause: Monolithic client components fetched video manifests and student progress synchronously inside client hooks, blocking main-thread rendering.
incident_postmortems.fix: Decomposed page into Server Components streaming the initial shell via React Suspense, offloading telemetry syncing to deferred client hooks.
incident_postmortems.outcome: Instant initial page paint, sub-50ms interaction response, zero layout shift (CLS), and seamless video player initialization.

incident_postmortems.title: High-Frequency WebSocket Orderbook Feed Throttling
incident_postmortems.symptom: Browser tab frame rate drops below 20 FPS and high client CPU usage during volatile crypto market events with 100+ updates per second.
incident_postmortems.root_cause: Every incoming WebSocket packet triggered an immediate React state update and complete recalculation of 50,000+ chart data points.
incident_postmortems.fix: Implemented an in-memory queue that batches incoming ticks at 1.5s intervals, combined with Largest Triangle Three Buckets (LTTB) downsampling on chart renders.
incident_postmortems.outcome: Smooth 60 FPS rendering under extreme market volatility, 70% reduction in client CPU utilization, and eliminated memory leak risks.
